program.help:
Convert an AlphaOmega .mat recording (HDF5 v7.3 format) to the neurosuite-3 .dat binary and a full session YAML parameter file.
PARAMETERS
# matFile
Path to the input AlphaOmega .mat file. Can be absolute or relative to the session directory (e.g. recording.mat or /data/jg05/recording.mat).
OPTIONAL PARAMETERS
Note: Optional parameters have default values shown. To override, click 'Add' and enter the parameter name and value.
# topology
Mixed probe topology string defining spike groups. Format: FIRST-LAST:SIZE,... where FIRST and LAST are 1-based channel numbers (inclusive) and SIZE is the number of channels per spike group. Group type is inferred from SIZE: SIZE=4 → tetrode, SIZE=1 → single electrode, any other value → linear/silicon shank.
Example for a recording with a 16-channel linear shank on channels 1-16 and four tetrodes on channels 17-32: topology: 1-16:16,17-32:4
When topology is absent, channels are split uniformly into groups of 'groups' channels each.
# groups
Uniform channels per spike group when topology is not specified (default = 8). Ignored when topology is provided.
# chunkSamples
Number of samples per streaming read chunk (default = 10000000, approximately 610 MB for a 32-channel recording). Reduce on systems with less than 32 GB RAM. The default is tuned for systems with 64 GB or more.
